events.headline: Appian Corp (APPN) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Appian extended its streak of EPS beats to seven consecutive quarters on November 5. The company posted a non-GAAP EPS of $0.51, nearly double the consensus estimate, alongside a 25% revenue increase. Updated FY2026 guidance was significantly higher than analyst expectations, providing a strong fundamental floor despite sector-wide tech volatility.
providers.risk: Vulnerability to the ongoing sector rotation and regulatory fears impacting high-growth software and AI-adjacent stocks.

providers.reason: Q3 revenue of $234.6M beat by about $18M, non-GAAP EPS of $0.51 beat by $0.18, cloud net ARR expansion reached 120%, and FY26 EPS guidance implies roughly 100% growth. William Blair issued an Outperform recommendation, supporting estimate revisions and momentum.
providers.risk: After a >150% YTD rally, APPN trades far above its $38.80 mean price target; profit-taking or a software-led risk-off reversal could overwhelm the post-earnings bid.

providers.reason: Q3 revenue $234.6M +25% beat, EPS $0.51 vs $0.33 on 50% sequential AI usage jump; raised FY revenue to $873-877M with EPS doubling to $1.20-$1.24.
providers.risk: Up >150% from lows into software rout; in-line Q4 EPS guide $0.30-$0.34 may limit chase if AI-caution resumes.
